description: Find M2 (creature, doodad, prop) and WMO (building, dungeon) models in the game's listfile by path fragment, or resolve a numeric FileDataID. Returns the FileDataID and path to pass to wow_model_export. Needs the game-data sync.

query.description: Words that appear in the path, e.g. 'thunder bluff' or 'cairne', or a FileDataID.

name: wow_model_search
title: Search game models
